recipe.name: Kairi Thecha Picante
recipe.description: A fiery and mouth-puckering tequila cocktail combining the sharp, tangy punch of green mango with the bold, savory heat of traditional thecha.
steps: Add the Camino Blanco, kairi thecha cordial, and fresh lime juice into a cocktail shaker.
Fill the shaker with cubed ice and shake vigorously for 10-12 seconds until well-chilled.
Strain the mixture into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
recipe.garnish: Slit green chili or raw mango slice
recipe.serving: Serve immediately over a large ice block with a chili garnish.
